{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Autumn Blazer in Slate Grey (#5D6E7A) with a structured lapel and tailored fit, crafted from wool-blend tweed.
High-Waisted Trousers in Charcoal (#36454F) featuring a slim silhouette and ankle-length hem, made of stretch cotton twill.
Silk Blouse in Cream (#F5F5DC) with a relaxed drape and rounded neckline, constructed from lightweight satin weave.
Loafers in Oxblood Brown (#8B2E2C) with a low heel and smooth leather upper.
Statement Necklace in Gold (#FFD700) featuring geometric links to add sparkle under artificial lighting.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance between elegant and comfortable for an evening date at a restaurant, especially given the possibility of rain which makes closed-toe shoes essential. The neutral palette of greys and creams harmonizes beautifully with her warm skin tones and golden hair while allowing the deep brown accessories to provide a sophisticated pop of color. The textured tweed jacket adds necessary warmth and style for autumn weather without appearing too stiff for a romantic social setting."}
